_meta.note: Machine-readable mirror of the DerivedStatCatalog for tooling that cannot reference FusionRpg.Core (seedsmith, the web app, importers). Registration itself stays code-first in Stats/Derived/DerivedStatRegistry.cs - this file describes it, it does not drive it.
_meta.families-not-channels: Entries are FAMILIES plus the axis they expand over, never the expanded channel list. The 196 combat channels are generated from CombatChannelFamilies x (omni + roster) precisely so adding an element or a family changes the count by construction; hand-listing the expansion here would create a second source of truth with a delay fuse. Expand axis='element' over data/seed/elements/roster.json the same way Core does.
_meta.shipped-only: Registered channels only, still true. catalog-extension (T2, derived-stats program, 2026-08-24) registered the 157-channel combat-balance extension (H.1-H.7 in actor-hub-ssot.md SS3H) in DerivedStatRegistry -- it is no longer PROPOSED, it is SHIPPED, with every new channel defaulting to 0 and zero readers wired (registration only; the reader modules land in later phases). move.range moved here from notRegistered accordingly.
_meta.counts: 9 progression (7 + 2 new) + 24 status constants (8 + 16 new) + 196 combat (84 + 112 new) + 1 healing + 15 resource + 1 move.range + 10 action-category = 256 named, plus 9 open prefix families (5 original + 4 new status-duration/intensity). Verified against DerivedStatRegistry.CreateDefault() 2026-08-24; DerivedStatRegistryTests asserts the combat total (196) and SeedCatalogMatchesCode asserts this mirror against the live registry.
_meta.composeKinds: FlatSum | FlatReplace | SumIncreased | MaxPriorityFlag - see DerivedComposeKind.
_meta.classification: TWO orthogonal axes, both required, neither inferred from the other. statClass (Contest|Race|Pool|Feeder) answers 'does it need a counterpart' - spec-stat-taxonomy.md; null statClass means the counterbalance rule does not apply (the two Theta channels only). unitClass answers 'what arithmetic is it and how does it render' - the TEN-class ledger in docs/design/spec-magnitude-and-units.md SS3 (nine plus LadderIndex, added 2026-08-24), each class verified against its consumer in src/. null unitClass means that ledger has not assigned one; per its SS8 a channel whose consumer cannot be named gets a REJECTION, never an invented placeholder -- true of every one of catalog-extension's 157 new channels at registration time. Do not add a third scheme.
